gaps.sentence: I was made ___ the dustbin lorry at six in the morning.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, make takes the to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: If you keep ___ like this, you'll exhaust yourself.
gaps.explanation: keep (+ on) is followed by -ing: keep working.

gaps.sentence: I look forward to ___ your suggestions at the meeting.
I'm learning ___ the guitar at the moment.
gaps.explanation: learn takes the to-infinitive (learn how to play).

gaps.sentence: My parents wouldn't let me ___ out that late.
gaps.explanation: let takes the bare infinitive: let me go (no 'to').

gaps.sentence: He was the first climber ___ the summit without oxygen.
gaps.explanation: After 'the first/last/only + noun' a to-infinitive follows.

gaps.sentence: We're thinking of ___ to the coast for the weekend.
